text:
nora: quick pilot idea — micro launch: 20 credits + 3-prompt "starter pack" + gated 25m webinar + coordinated social push. measure signup->first-gen within 7 days.
ash: whats the core hypothesis and target lift?
nora: hypothesis: combined touch (social + webinar + credits) increases 7-day activation by ~8%. primary metric = % signups who run 3 generations within 7d.
leo: can host a 25m session wed May 28 11:00 PT, live demo + prompts walkthrough. RSVP page ok?
nora: yes please. RSVP flow: small form (company size + enterprise interest checkbox) so we can tag sales-ready leads. attendance-only credit grant.
ops-bot: reminder: workflow "starter_credit_grant" requires manager approval before cohort write. ping @nora for approval.
nash: segment = new signups 0-30 days with zero generations, exclude paid trials and existing customers. ash -> can you export by EOD tmrw?
ash: on it. will drop CSV in the drive and share link here.
product-bot: tracking: add utm_source=mini_launch&utm_medium=social_webinar&utm_campaign=mini_may28 and hidden param route=starterpack on banner links. first-gen event must carry utm+route for attribution.
leo: RSVP page will include route param and capture utm. I'll also add a hidden field for user_id to help dedupe. RSVP URL draft: https://rsvp.redwood.example/mini-launch (mock).
nora: banner AB test: short CTA vs benefit CTA on homepage only. keep email copy identical. banner AB split 60 exposed : 40 control.
nash: draft CTAs: short = "Get 20 credits + 3 prompts  Join a 25m webinar"; long = "Join a short demo + get 20 starter credits and 3 prompts to ship faster." will add both to drive.
ops-bot: calendar event created: "Mini Launch: Starter Pack Webinar" Wed May 28 11:00 PT.
product-bot: analytics: I'll build a funnel dashboard (impressions->rsvp->attend->first-gen). set alert if attend < 30% of RSVPs and if first-gen conversion < baseline -5%.
leo: deck and prompt pack (3 short templates) uploaded to drive by tues EOD: https://drive.redwood.example/mini-launch (check perms).
nora: credit policy: 20 credits, attendance-only, grant at T+0, nudge at T+24h if unused. approval step required.
nash: control size ok? 60/40 exposed/control means we need ~900 users for power. I'll compute exact N and confirm.
product-bot: make sure first-gen SDK event includes utm_source and route fields and that analytics dedupes by user_id.
leo: will host and run smoke test after AB goes live.
nora: owners: ash = segment + export + banner AB; leo = host + RSVP page + deck; product-bot = analytics + dashboard + SDK check; nora = prompt pack + credit approval + copy.
nash: syncing tues 10am for go/no-go. small ask: prefer cookie-free attribution (user-id first) to avoid cross-device split.
product-bot: noted, will dedupe by user_id and fall back to cookie if missing.
nora: thanks team  let's keep banner copy tight and the prompt pack supes simple (1-sentence TL;DR, 1-sentence tone rewrite, 1-sentence feature brainstorm). :rocket:
